messages:
Ari: FYI - presenter's laptop is scaling slides weirdly, causing intermittent flicker on the stream. Looks like a 4K->1080p mismatch.
Sam: Can we mirror the slide deck from the backup laptop? It'll avoid re-scaling.
Nina: Backup ready at Stage Right. If we swap, expect a 20s visual gap and captions may need a quick reset.
Ari: Hosts, recommend moving leadership Q&A to the end of the segment while we swap decks so Olivia isn't mid-answer during the cut. @Olivia (CEO)
Olivia (CEO): Okay to defer. Please announce to audience and note the change on the overlay.
Leo: Running the swap now. Command I used on the presentation switcher:
```
# switcher command
presctl route --from=presenter-laptop --to=backup-laptop --fade=2s
```
Leo: Swap complete. Slides stable on stream now. Please confirm if captions are aligned.
Nina: Captions reconnected, small ~0.8s drift but holding. I'll run a resync after the segment if needed.
Sam: Uploaded the final deck to the drive during the swap (allhands/decks/final_roadmap_v3.pdf).
Ari: Announced on-stage and updated the on-screen banner: "Leadership Q&A moved to post-demo - details in 5".
stream-bot: [automated] Stream telemetry: cpu=65%, viewers=1.1k, latency=1.9s
Olivia (CEO): Thanks team. After the demo, I'll take the pre-submitted roadmap question first, then two live audience questions.
Ari: Noted. I'll reserve a 30s runway after demo for stabilization before Olivia's cue. Hosts briefed.
Nina: Recorder note - we have a split at the swap point. Paths: /recordings/allhands/part_before_swap.mp4 and /recordings/allhands/part_after_swap.mp4
Sam: I'll handle a quick merge and mark the cut for editors with timestamp.
Ari: Great job. I'll post a short ops recap in #all-hands with the timestamps and recommended caption merge steps. :thumbsup:
